blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Event cameras are increasingly used for Multiple Object Tracking (MOT), but their asynchronous event output often requires specialized methods. Existing processing methods primarily follow two paradigms, pseudo-frames and event-by-event. The former is the prevailing approach since its data format aligns with images, making image-based techniques applicable. However, it suffers from tracking failures when trajectories overlap or are spatially close on pseudo-frames. Facing this challenge, we propose a multi-view pipeline, Multi-view Tracking (MvT), which preserves the 2D data format to leverage image-based techniques directly while introducing additional spatio-temporal views to resolve tracking ambiguities in a single view. MvT comprises a Multi-view Projection (MvP) module and a Multi-view Fusion (MvF) stage. MvP encodes events into three complementary spatio-temporal views while mitigating the pattern discretization. Within MvF, multi-view results are unified into a 3D coordinate system, and tracklets are associated through an optimization model subject to specific criteria combination. Evaluations on four datasets, including our self-collected Small Objects Dataset (SOD), show that MvT seamlessly integrates image-based methods and outperforms existing non-learning and learning trackers in generalized scenarios, and effectively resolves the single-view tracking ambiguities. Being training-free, MvT is applicable when ground-truth annotation is infeasible, thereby highlighting its practical, data-efficient potential. Code is available at https://github.com/zhazhabiu/MvTracking.
blocks.zh: 事件相机被越来越多地用于多物体跟踪(MOT),但其同步事件输出往往需要专门的方法. 现有的处理方法主要遵循两个范式,即伪框和事件逐一处理. 前者是通行的方法,因为其数据格式与图像一致,使基于图像的技术得以适用。 然而,当轨迹重叠或空间接近于伪框时,它会遇到跟踪故障. 面对这一挑战,我们提议采用多视图管道-多视图跟踪(MvT),它保留了2D数据格式来直接利用以图像为基础的技术,同时引入了额外的斯皮提奥-时态观点,以解决单一视图中的跟踪模糊性. MvT包含一个多视图投影(MvP)模块和一个多视图融合(MvF)阶段. MvP将事件编码为三个互补的spatio-timperal视图,同时缓解了模式盘式. 在MvF内部,多视图结果被统一为一个3D坐标系统,通过一个受具体标准组合约束的优化模型来连接轨道. 对包括自取自用的小物体数据集(SOD)在内的四个数据集的评价显示,MvT无缝地整合了以图像为基础的方法并超越了通用情景中现有的非学习和学习跟踪器,并有效解决了单视跟踪的模糊性. 由于MvT是无培训的,因此,当地面真实说明不可行时,MvT就适用,从而突出其实际的、数据效率高的潜力。 代码见https://github.com/zhazhabiu/MvTracking.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Multiple Object Tracking (MOT) serves as a fundamental tool for various applications, such as pose estimation [ 1 , 2 ] and autonomous driving assistance [ 3 ] . Image-based trackers excel in precision but struggle under challenging conditions (e.g., ground-based UAV observation). Event cameras offer a promising alternative [ 4 ] with high dynamic range, low latency, and fast response to stimuli in these extreme environments. However, their asynchronous event output is fundamentally different from images, as shown in Fig. 1 (a). Specialized event-based tracking methods have been developed [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] , but they mainly leverage the high dynamic range and low latency of event cameras to achieve real-time tracking. With the special motion sensitivity of event cameras, this paper focuses on small object tracking, which is more challenging than standard MOT due to issues such as small sizes and similar appearance features.
blocks.zh: 多种物体跟踪(MOT)是各种应用的基本工具,例如:平面估计[1,2]和自主驾驶协助[3]。 基于图像的跟踪仪精度很高,但在具有挑战性的条件下(例如地面无人驾驶航空器观测)进行斗争。 事件摄像头提供了一个很有希望的替代[4],具有高动态范围,低延迟性,并在这些极端环境中对刺激反应迅速. 然而,如图1(a)所示,它们的同步事件输出与图像有着根本的不同. 专门基于事件的跟踪方法已经开发[5,6,7],但它们主要利用事件摄像头的高动态范围和低延迟性来实现实时跟踪. 由于事件相机具有特殊的运动敏感性,本文关注小物体跟踪,由于尺寸小,外观特征相似等问题,这比标准MOT更具有挑战性.

blocks.en: Each output event contains four elements, spatial coordinates ( x , y ) (x,y) , timestamps t t , and polarity p p . Current event-based tracking methods often process them in two formats, pseudo-frames [ 8 , 9 ] and event-by-event [ 7 , 10 ] , as depicted in Fig. 1 (b) and (c). The first approach generates pseudo-frames from events, including event images, voxel-grids, time surfaces, etc. Since this format aligns with images, which are intuitive and convenient to process, the majority of event-based tracking works [ 5 , 6 , 11 , 12 ] are built upon it. Compared to real images, most pseudo-frame representations lack dense color and texture information, which serves as critical appearance cues for tracking. Although some studies [ 13 , 14 ] have successfully utilized event polarity, which encodes the luminance gradient fields, to recover texture and intensity images, commonly used event images lack such rich cues. Furthermore, they simply collapse the temporal dimension of events, which can lead to tracking failures when object trajectories overlap or intersect in the image plane.
blocks.zh: 每个输出事件包含四个要素,空间坐标(x,y)(x,y),时间戳 t,和极性p. 目前的基于事件的跟踪方法往往以两种形式处理,即假帧[8,9]和逐项事件[7,10],图1(b)和(c)对此作了描述。 第一种方法产生事件产生的伪框架,包括事件图像,voxel-grids,时间表面等. 由于这种格式与图像一致,而图像是直观的,便于处理的,所以大多数基于事件的跟踪作品[5,6,11,12]都是建立在它之上的. 与真实的图像相比,大多数伪框的表示缺乏密集的色彩和纹理信息,成为跟踪的关键外观提示. 虽然有些研究[13,14]成功地利用了事件极性,它编码了亮度梯度字段,以恢复纹理和强度图像,但常用的事件图像缺乏如此丰富的提示. 此外,它们只是使事件的时间维度崩溃,这可能导致在物体轨迹在图像平面中重叠或交叉时跟踪故障.

blocks.en: Event-by-event processing preserves the original sequential temporal nature of events. Beyond emerging Spiking Neural Networks (SNN) [ 12 , 15 ] , clustering techniques [ 16 , 17 , 7 , 18 ] are used widely since they are training-free. These methods regard events as point clouds distributed in t-x-y space. However, unlike standard 3D point clouds with homogeneous axis units in z-x-y, the heterogeneous units of t-x-y axes complicate parameter selections. Specifically, first, the high temporal resolution and asynchronous nature cause a relatively sparser distribution along t-axis compared to the spatial dimensions, thus requiring disparate clustering parameters for different axes. Second, the temporal distribution of an event trajectory is velocity-dependent, rendering it hard to determine parameters for objects with diverse motion patterns. Though this format avoids the tracking ambiguities in above pseudo-frames, these issues limit its generalizability.
blocks.zh: 事件逐项处理保留了事件的最初顺序时间性质. 除了新兴的Spiking神经网络(SNN)[12,15]之外,集束技术[16,17,7,18]因为没有训练,所以被广泛使用. 这些方法将事件视为在t-x-y空间分布的点云. 然而,与z-x-y中同轴单位的标准3D点云不同,t-x-y轴的不同单位使参数选择复杂化. 具体来说,首先,高时间分辨率和同步性导致与空间维度相比,T轴沿线分布相对较少,因此不同轴线需要不同的集群参数. 第二,事件轨迹的时间分布取决于速度,因此很难确定具有不同运动模式的物体的参数。 虽然这种格式避免了上述伪框架的跟踪模糊,但这些问题限制了其普遍性。

blocks.en: Given the processing ease and straightforward parameter determination of pseudo-frames, alongside the rich spatio-temporal information of event-by-event processing for trajectory disambiguation, an open problem arises. How can the tracking ambiguities inherent in single pseudo-frames be resolved? Considering the difficulty in obtaining ground truth annotations from events, we move away from prevailing supervised network designs.
blocks.zh: 鉴于伪框架的处理容易,参数的确定也简单明了,加上对事件逐项处理的丰富的时空信息,从而导致轨道混乱,出现了一个未决问题。 如何解决单一假框固有的追踪模糊性? 考虑到难以从事件中获取地面真相说明,我们不再采用主流的受监督的网络设计。

MvP generates multiple views through time-realigned events. In MvF, complete trajectories are recovered from the segmentation results of multiple views. blocks.en: In this paper, we provide a novel generalizable framework MvT, to integrate existing image-based methods into event-based tracking task. To ensure compatibility with image-based methods, MvT preserves the pseudo-frame format. The overall pipeline is shown in Fig. 2 . It encodes events into a multi-view representation through its component, MvP. The generated views include a spatial view, XOY, and two spatio-temporal views, YOT and TOX. This representation overcomes the information limitation of a single pseudo-frame. Image-based detection/segmentation methods are then applied to views. The other component of MvT, named MvF, fuses results from each view and maps them back into the original t-x-y coordinates. If there are detection or segmentation errors in some views, MvF can leverage complementary information provided by other views to correct results through an isolation scheme. Subsequently, an association stage is performed on the corrected results. To accommodate the modality of event data, we design three association criteria based on the motion consistency of event trajectories.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提供了一个全新的通用框架MvT,将现有的基于图像的方法整合到基于事件的跟踪任务中. 为确保与基于图像的方法兼容,MvT保留了伪帧格式. 整个管道如图2所示。 它通过其组件MvP将事件编码为多视图代表. 生成的视图包括空间视图XOY和两个Spatio-时空视图YOT和TOX. 这种表述方式克服了单一伪框架的信息限制。 然后对视图采用基于图像的检测/分解方法。 MvT的另一部分命名为MvF,引信来自每个视图,并将其映射回原T-x-y坐标. 如果在某些观点中存在检测或分解错误,MvF可以利用其他观点提供的补充信息,通过隔离计划纠正结果. 随后,在经过修正的结果上进行了联系阶段。 为了适应事件数据的模式,我们根据事件轨迹的运动一致性设计了三个关联标准.

blocks.en:
In experiments, we integrate both non-learning and learning-based methods into MvT, and compare them against carefully devised pseudo-frame and event-by-event methods. Evaluations are conducted on four datasets, including Event Camera Dataset (ECD) [ 19 ] , Bee Swarm Dataset (BEES) [ 20 ] , EV-UAV [ 21 ] , and our self-collected Small Objects Dataset (SOD). Except for ECD, the remaining three datasets cover small-sized objects and various motion patterns.
The main contributions of this paper are as follows: • We propose MvT, a generalized and training-free event-based MOT framework that enables the direct application of image-based methods while preserving the temporal information of events for tracking. • We devise an association model comprising three criteria, corresponding to three cases derived from short-term and long-term event trajectory relationships. These criteria can be flexibly combined to handle diverse association scenarios involving both normal-sized and small-sized objects. • Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness and compatibility of MvT with various image-based detection and segmentation methods, as well as the efficacy of the multi-view representation.
blocks.zh:
在实验中,我们把非学习和基于学习的方法整合到MvT中,并与精心设计的伪框架和事件处理方法进行比较. 对四个数据集进行评价,包括事件相机数据集[19],蜂鼠数据集[20],EV-UAV[21],以及我们自收集的小物体数据集(SOD)。 除ECD外,其余三个数据集涵盖小型物体和各种运动模式.
本文件的主要贡献如下: 我们提议采用MvT,这是一个通用的、无培训的MOT框架,它能够直接应用基于图像的方法,同时保存事件的时间信息以进行跟踪。 我们设计了一个包括三个标准的联系模式,与从短期和长期事件轨迹关系得出的三个案例相对应。 这些标准可以灵活地结合起来,以处理涉及正常大小物体的各种关联情况。 • 广泛的实验验证了MvT与各种基于图像的检测和分解方法的有效性和兼容性,以及多视图表示的功效。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: We provide a review of event-based tracking methods, covering both pseudo-frames and event-by-event paradigms. We then introduce the multi-view representation in image processing and spike-based coding, which collectively inspire the design of our event representation.
blocks.zh: 我们审查了基于事件的跟踪方法,既包括假框架,也包括事件逐一模式。 然后,我们引入了图像处理中的多视图表示和基于悬赏的编码,这共同启发了我们事件表示的设计.

blocks.en: II-A Pseudo-frame Tracking
blocks.zh: II-A 专题跟踪

blocks.en:
Pseudo-frames refer to 2D images constructed from events, such as event images [ 8 ] , Image of Warped Events (IWE) [ 9 ] , and voxel-grids [ 22 , 15 ] , with IWE being a well-known form that accumulates events warped by motion models. This type of frame is typically processed using maximization optimization, such as Entropy Maximization (EM) [ 23 , 24 ] , Expectation Maximization-Iterative Closest Point (EM-ICP) [ 25 ] , Contrast Maximization (CM) [ 9 , 8 , 26 , 27 , 28 ] , and Spatio-temporal Consistency Maximization [ 29 ] . For example, Zhu et al. [ 25 ] introduce an optical flow method based on Expectation Maximization that maximizes all correlation expectations of soft data associations for feature tracking. In other pseudo-frame-based works, Zhang et al. [ 22 ] design cross-domain attention schemes that combine the information from RGB frames and voxel-grid-based event frames to guide object tracking.
Zhang et al. [ 15 ] then generate positive-negative event frames and feed them into a transformer module for global spatial information, as well as a spiking neural network (SNN) for temporal clues. With these clues, a single object is accurately detected and tracked. Since event images cannot fully utilize temporal information, researchers have explored diverse pseudo-frames that integrate more temporal information. For example, the Surface of Active Events (SAE) [ 30 ] stores timestamps as pixel values and has been used to estimate optical flow. Subsequently, a Time-Surface map, which stores exponentially decayed timestamps, was introduced as a prototype of event-based object recognition tasks [ 31 ] and has since been extended as a popular representation in motion estimation [ 32 , 33 ] . Chen et al. [ 5 , 6 ] propose an Adaptive Time-Surface with Linear Time Decay (ATSLTD) frame representation and a Time-Surface with Linear Time Decay (TSLTD) representation. Almareafi et al. [ 34 ] introduce a prototype target texture that captures temporal distance variations in events. These representations retain temporal information by encoding timestamps into pixel values, but they may lose other details, like the number of triggers at each pixel. Mitrokhin et al. [ 35 ] propose using a Time-image to assist event images in jointly estimating motions.

blocks.en: II-B Event-by-event Tracking
blocks.zh: II-B 事件跟踪

blocks.en: To fully leverage the low latency of event cameras, many asynchronous processing methods bypass frame generation, categorizing object tracking into one-stage and two-stage approaches. In one-stage methods, deep learning models, like Vision Transformers (ViT) [ 36 ] and SNNs serve as a supervised solution mainly for Single Object Tracking (SOT) [ 12 , 15 ] , while unsupervised clustering offers a more general alternative applicable to MOT without extensive training [ 16 , 17 , 10 ] . However, varying target speeds cause unstable performance due to non-fixed clustering criteria. Two-stage pipelines separate detection and tracking. The detection stage utilizes not only clustering methods [ 37 , 7 , 18 ] but also some visual feature-based methods [ 38 , 39 , 40 ] . The tracking stage associates tracklets across batches similar to image-based tracking. Several methods have been developed, including searching features or templates in the neighborhood [ 37 , 40 ] , matching target descriptors across adjacent time steps [ 18 ] , and employing Kalman filters [ 7 , 38 , 41 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了充分发挥事件摄像头的低延迟性,许多同步处理方法绕过帧生成,将物体跟踪分为一个阶段和两个阶段的方法. 在单阶段方法中,深层学习模式,如Visual Transformers(ViT)[36]和SNNs,主要作为单一物体跟踪(SOT)[12,15]的受监督解决方案,而不受监督的集群则提供了更一般的替代方案,适用于没有广泛培训的MOT[16,17,10]. 然而,由于非固定的集群标准,不同的目标速度导致性能不稳定. 两级管线分离检测和跟踪. 探测阶段不仅采用组合方法[37、7、18],而且还采用一些基于视觉特征的方法[38、39、40]。 跟踪阶段将不同批次的轨迹联系起来,类似于基于图像的跟踪. 已经开发出几种方法,包括在附近搜索特征或模板[37,40],在相邻的时间步骤上匹配目标描述符[18],并使用卡尔曼过滤器[7,38,41].

blocks.en: II-C Multi-view based works
blocks.zh: II-C多视图作品

blocks.en: Event data can be regarded as point clouds in the T-X-Y space. In processing point clouds, leveraging multiple views is a common strategy to obtain more information than a single view provides. “Multiple views” typically carries two meanings, views at different timestamps (video sequences) and views from different perspectives. In our work, we focus on the latter, which is more relevant to event data. Among multi-view forms, orthographic views are particularly effective, being used for reconstruction via geometric constraints [ 42 ] , and for classification using morphological information [ 43 ] . This principle persists in modern neural representations. For example, the Triplane representation in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) [ 44 , 45 ] uses three 2D feature planes, facilitating the application of 2D convolutional networks. Multi-view representation is also used in spike-based coding. Thorpe et al. [ 46 ] propose Rank Order Coding, which involves projecting spatio-temporal data onto three 2D planes (X-T, Y-T, and X-Y). This projection scheme has been explored in neuroscience [ 47 ] and applied to image processing [ 48 ] , establishing a foundational method for converting temporal event streams into informative 2D maps.

blocks.en: III-A Motivation
blocks.zh: 三、A 动力

blocks.en:
While image-based detection or segmentation methods have demonstrated remarkable success, their direct application to event-based tracking remains challenging due to modality shift. As analyzed in Sec. I , existing event-based tracking approaches face two primary challenges.
(1) Single pseudo-frame representations contain limited spatio-temporal information. When objects overlap or their trajectories intersect in the 2D projection, these representations fail to distinguish them (Fig. 3 (a)).
(2) The spatio-temporal units (t-x-y) are not homogeneous. The inherent mismatch between temporal ( μ ​ s \mu s ) and spatial (pixel) units, combined with the asynchronous triggering mechanism, results in sparse and non-uniform event distributions. As illustrated in Fig. 3 (b), varying target speeds lead to distinctly different event densities (total event counts per unit of recording period) along trajectories, thereby posing difficulties for parameter selection. We summarize this as Claim 1 . The proof is provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
虽然基于图像的检测或分解方法取得了显著的成功,但由于模式的转变,直接应用于基于事件的跟踪仍然具有挑战性。 正如第1节所分析的那样,现有的基于事件的跟踪方法面临两大挑战。
(1) 单一的伪框架表述包含有限的时空信息。 当物体重叠或其轨迹在2D投影中交叉时,这些表示无法区分它们(图3(a))。
(2) 时空单位(t-x-y)不均匀。 时间(μs \mu s)和空间(像素)单位之间的内在不匹配,加之同步触发机制,导致事件分布稀少和不统一. 如图3(b)所示,不同的目标速度导致在轨迹上明显不同的事件密度(每单位记录期的总事件计数),从而对参数的选择造成困难。 我们将此总结为索赔1。 补充材料中提供了证据。

blocks.en: Moreover, although the high temporal resolution of event cameras enables tracking to be treated as a trajectory segmentation problem, it introduces a side effect, discretization. From a macroscopic perspective, trajectories can be regarded as continuous 3D lines or volumes. However, at the micro-time scale, they comprise discretely distributed events (Fig. 3 (b)). In this work, we consider both temporal discretization resulting from sparse event triggering and spatial discretization caused by the physical artifact of pixel-based sensor arrays.
blocks.zh: 此外,虽然事件摄像头的高时间分辨率能够将跟踪作为轨迹分割问题处理,但它引入了副作用,即盘状化. 从宏观角度来看,轨迹可以看作是连续的3D线或卷. 然而,在微观时间尺度上,它们包括分散分布的活动(图3(b))。 在这项工作中,我们既考虑因零星事件触发而产生的时间磁盘化,也考虑由以像素为基础的传感器阵列的物理文物引起的空间磁盘化。

blocks.en:
For the first challenge, our multi-view representation adopts the 2D view format that enables the application of image-based algorithms while using multiple views to preserve essential spatio-temporal information for trajectory discrimination.
As for the second challenge and the discretization issue, we introduce a time realignment method designed for asynchronously triggered events, alongside a Gaussian pyramid, to alleviate the tracklet pattern discontinuities caused by spatio-temporal discretization.
blocks.zh:
对于第一项挑战,我们的多视图表示采用了2D视图格式,该格式允许应用基于图像的算法,同时使用多种观点来保存基本的时空信息,用于轨迹歧视.
关于第二个挑战和盘片化问题,我们采用了一个时间调整方法,与高斯金字塔一起,为同步触发的事件设计一个时间调整方法,以缓解时空盘片化造成的轨迹模式不连续性。

blocks.en: III-B MvT Architecture
blocks.zh: III-B MvT 结构

blocks.en: MvT processes raw events (i.e. Dynamic Vision Sensor signals) and outputs event trajectories rather than bounding boxes. Input event streams are partitioned into non-overlapping batches based on a fixed event count or a fixed time window. Each batch is first encoded by MvP to generate the multi-view representation. Results obtained by image-based methods are then passed to MvF for complete trajectory recovery. Since views produced by MvP are independent, the image-based algorithm can be executed in parallel for efficiency.
blocks.zh: MvT处理原始事件(即动态视觉传感器信号)和输出事件轨迹而非边框. 输入事件流根据固定事件计数或固定时间窗口被分割成非重叠批次. 每个批次首先由MvP编码生成多视图代表. 然后,通过基于图像的方法获得的结果转给MvF,以便完全恢复轨迹。 由于MvP产生的视图是独立的,因此基于图像的算法可以同步执行,以提高效率.

The quality of realigned timestamps is affected by two primary factors, multiple object velocities and noise that often refers to background activity (BA) events [ 49 , 50 , 51 ] . Regarding the former, when objects exhibit varying planar velocities, the trajectories of slow-moving objects tend to be more fragmented and sparse along the temporal axis than those of fast-moving objects. However, the association model proposed in Sec. III-D can handle this fragmentation. With respect to the latter, BA noise introduces two distinct problems. First, it can distort the realigned timestamps away from their ideal (noise-free) values, leading to trajectory fragmentation. This issue is similarly addressed by the association model. Second, BA events may be wrongly detected as part of a tracklet. Given the inherently random and independent nature of BA events [ 52 ] , even if a single noise event coincidentally overlaps with a tracklet in one 2D view, the probability of it consistently falling on the tracklet across all views is low. Consequently, the majority of BA events can be distinguished through cross-view validation.

III-D中提出的关联模式可以处理这种分裂. 关于后者,BA噪声提出了两个不同的问题。 首先,它可以扭曲调整的时间戳远离其理想的(无噪声)值,导致轨迹破碎. 协会模式也同样涉及这一问题。 其次,BA事件可能作为轨道的一部分被错误检测. 鉴于BA事件固有的随机性和独立性[52],即使一个单一的噪音事件偶然与一个2D视图中的轨道重叠,它在所有视图中持续落在轨道上的概率仍然很低. 因此,大多数BA活动可以通过交叉视图验证加以区分。

blocks.en: Gaussian pyramid. Time realignment alleviates temporal sparsity, but discontinuities in tracklet patterns across the views persist due to spatial discretization and residual temporal sparsity. We employ a Gaussian pyramid consisting of dual pathways, bottom-up and top-down, to compensate for missing trajectory details where events are not triggered. By default, we set two scales for each pathway. This generates views with relatively continuous trajectory patterns, facilitating accurate detection and segmentation.
blocks.zh: 高斯金字塔. 时间调整可以缓解时间的伸缩,但由于空间盘状和剩余时间的伸缩,整个观点的轨道模式的不连续性持续存在。 我们使用一个高斯金字塔,由双路径组成,自下而上和自上而下,以弥补没有触发事件的缺失轨迹细节. 默认情况下,我们为每个路径设置了两个比例尺。 这会产生具有相对连续的轨迹规律的视野,有利于准确的探测和分割.

A simple filtering rule based on event count is applied to the final output to exclude isolated noise.

Therefore, BA events are high-frequency anomalies superimposed on the ideal event output. When the Gaussian kernel is applied, neighboring pixels are averaged, which can suppress the influence of BA events. The top-down pathway upsamples the scaled frame. The pyramid design compensates for missing textures while incorporating an anti-aliasing kernel to minimize the impact of artificial artifacts. A detailed experimental analysis of this pyramid design is provided in Sec. IV-G .

blocks.en: III-D MvF
blocks.zh: 三维MvF

blocks.en: MvF is the core stage for recovering complete trajectories from multi-view detection or segmentation results. As illustrated in Fig. 5 , this stage operates in two sequential phases: (1) tracklet isolation, which integrates all results to generate isolated tracklets that are independent across views, and (2) tracklet association, which links tracklets for complete trajectories via optimal assignment.
blocks.zh: MvF是从多视图检测或分解结果中恢复完整轨迹的核心阶段. 如图5所示,这一阶段分两个相继阶段运作:(1) 轨迹隔离,将所有结果整合在一起,生成独立跨视线的孤立轨迹;(2) 轨迹关联,通过优化任务将轨迹连接到完整轨迹.

blocks.en: Tracklet isolation. The isolation phase leverages complementary information from different views to resolve trajectory ambiguities caused by occlusions. This phase is further divided into two steps, temporal post-processing and multi-view tracklet isolation. Due to the discretization of tracklet patterns along the t-axis or algorithmic errors, initial detection/segmentation results of YOT and TOX often consist of numerous small regions, as shown in Fig. 6 (a) and (b). Since sparse event points yield less accurate direction vectors in the association phase, we introduce an iterative post-processing step to combine regions, as shown in Fig. 6 (c) and (d).

The dimensionality reduction in the pseudo-frame representation means that events mapped to the same pixel may originate from distinct objects, which prevents single pseudo-frame methods from distinguishing intersecting or overlapping tracks.
Our solution for disambiguation is guided by the principle that distinct 3D trajectories can be separated as long as they are non-overlapping in at least one of their 2D projections. We isolate tracklets by intersecting their inverse-projected 3D event sets, leveraging the fact that overlapping tracks in one view are often separated in others.

Tracklets association. The association phase handles two types of associations: (1) intra-batch association, resolving potential over-fragmentation due to isolation or inherent discontinuous trajectory patterns, and (2) inter-batch association, linking tracklets across different batches.
Although trajectories can be locally approximated as linear tracklets over short intervals, they often exhibit complex nonlinear patterns over extended periods due to the existence of varying forces, such as vehicle steering.
The inherent sparsity and asynchronicity of events further compound this challenge by producing non-smooth trajectory contours.
blocks.zh:
轨迹协会. 关联阶段处理两种类型的关联:(1) 囊内关联,解决因孤立或内在的不连续轨迹模式导致的潜在超裂化问题;(2) 囊间关联,将不同批次的轨道连接起来.
虽然轨迹在局部上可以短距离地近似为线性轨迹,但由于存在车辆向导等不同力量,它们往往在较长的时间内表现出复杂的非线性形态.
事件的内在伸缩性和同步性进一步加重了这一挑战,产生了非平滑的轨迹轮廓。

blocks.en: Despite these complexities, adjacent tracklets typically maintain motion continuity. We formulate tracklet association as an optimal assignment problem governed by three geometric criteria, the previously introduced Criterion 1 , along with Criterion 2 and 3 illustrated in Fig. 8 . Criterion 2 evaluates the coplanarity of two tracklets’ directions and their positional variation, while Criterion 3 assesses whether a valid spatio-temporal intersection I I exists between two tracklets.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些复杂性,相邻的轨道通常保持运动连续性。 我们将轨迹关联作为一个最佳分配问题,由三个几何标准来规范,即之前引入的标准1,以及图8所示的标准2和3。 标准2评价了两个轨迹方向及其位置变化的共性,而标准3则评估了两个轨迹之间是否存在有效的Sptio-时空I交叉点。

During intra-batch association, M ​ R MR is associated using Criterion 1 and 2 sequentially, while in inter-batch association, Criterion 2 and 3 are executed sequentially. It should be noted that Criterion 3 has limited applicability for small objects. Since tracklets generated by small targets consist of only a few sparsely distributed events, their directional vectors are highly susceptible to local interference events. Due to geometric amplification, even a minor deviation in the estimated direction can cause the computed intersection I I to drift far outside the ideal spatio-temporal regions. Conversely, larger objects often trigger a large number of events, yielding more stable direction estimates. Furthermore, their larger volumes provide more tolerance for spatial deviation. This is confirmed by our ablation study in the supplementary material. Although the combination of these criteria is flexible, Criterion 3 must be executed after Criterion 2 . Specifically, it is applied only to the remaining unmatched tracklet pairs because it imposes a looser constraint, and applying this less restrictive condition as a fallback does not degrade tracking performance. Following the association process, successfully matched trajectories retain their original IDs, whereas newly detected trajectories are assigned new ones.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四 试验

blocks.en:
Our experiments have four purposes. First, assess the generalization capability and tracking effectiveness of the proposed framework MvT by incorporating both non-learning and learning-based image-based detection and segmentation methods.
Second, compare MvT with existing pseudo-frame and event-by-event-based baselines, with a particular focus on small object tracking scenarios. Third, perform ablation studies to validate the contribution of components in MvT. Finally, sensitivity experiments on key parameters, including direction angle error Δ ​ θ \Delta\theta , sampling scale s s in Gaussian pyramid, and window size B B , are provided in the supplementary material. All evaluations are conducted on a platform with an Intel Core i7-7700HQ CPU @ 2.8GHz, 16G pf 2600MHz RAM and an NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti GPU. Since event cameras suffer from significant noise [ 56 ] , we apply an event count filter to all methods’ results to remove trajectories with fewer than m m events. m m is set to 20, which is lower than the total event count of a legitimate and complete trajectory.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验有四个目的。 首先,通过纳入非学习和基于学习的图像检测和分解方法,评估拟议框架MvT的一般化能力和跟踪有效性。
第二,将MvT与现有的假帧和事件逐项基准进行比较,特别侧重于小对象跟踪情景. 第三,进行减速研究,以验证MvT中组件的贡献。 最后,补充材料中提供了关键参数的敏感性实验,包括方向角误差 QQ\Delta\theta,高斯金字塔中的采样比例S,窗口大小B。 所有评价都在一个平台上进行,一个Intel Core i7-7700HQ CPU@2.8GHz,16G pf 2600MHz RAM和一个NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti GPU. 由于事件摄像头有显著的噪声[56],我们对所有方法的结果使用一个事件计数过滤器去除短于m m的事件的轨迹. m m 设置为20,低于一个合法和完整的轨道的总事件数。

blocks.en: Datasets. Experiments are conducted on four datasets with varying object scales, including three public datasets, ECD Shapes [ 19 ] , BEES [ 20 ] , and Ev-UAV [ 21 ] , and a self-collected dataset SOD. ECD is a standard bounding box-based MOT dataset, containing different shapes of objects with normal size ( > 25 × 25 >25\times 25 pixels) under three camera motions, translation, rotation, and 6DoF. BEES and Ev-UAV provide event-wise Ground Truth (GT) labels and focus on small objects ( ≤ 10 × 10 \leq 10\times 10 pixels) with complex and independent motion patterns. BEES, despite being a 5 s s recording, contains approximately 5 million events with 70 to 110 labeled bees. However, it only provides segmentation labels without distinguishing different trajectories. Ev-UAV includes both segmentation and tracking labels, but only a few UAVs ( ≤ \leq 5) appear in the test and validation sets.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 在四个不同对象尺度的数据集上进行实验,包括三个公共数据集,ECD形状[19],BEES[20],Ev-UAV[21],以及一个自收集的数据集SOD. ECD是一个标准的以框为基础的MOT数据集,包含具有正常大小( > 25×25>25\times 25像素)的物体的不同形状,在三种相机运动,翻译,旋转,和6DoF下. BEES和Ev-UAV提供事件感地真(GT)标签,并聚焦于具有复杂和独立运动模式的小物体(≤ 10 × 10\leq 10\times 10 像素). BEES虽然是5s的录音,但包含约500万个事件,有70到110个标记的蜜蜂. 然而,它只提供分化标签而不区分不同的轨迹. Ev-UAV既包括分解,也包括跟踪标签,但在测试和验证集中仅出现少量的UAV(~\leq 5).

blocks.en: Due to the limited number of datasets for small and multiple object tracking in event-based vision, we collect SOD to include small, independently fast-moving targets for evaluation. Unlike the previous three datasets with low spatial resolution ( 240 × 360 240\times 360 ) and a single moving element (either the camera or the objects), SOD is recorded using a high spatial resolution ( 720 × 1280 720\times 1280 ) event camera, Prophesee EVK4, and provides scenarios with both camera and object motion. It consists of two parts, real-world and simulated data, as listed in Table I . The real-world sequences are captured in three outdoor scenarios, tree, playground, and rain. Based on the target types and quantities, these are categorized as Sphere-20, Sphere-30, and Raindrops. Sphere-20 and Sphere-30 sequences record marbles thrown by hand in both tree and clean playground scenes, while the Raindrops sequences record falling raindrops. The simulated sequences are generated by screen-recording the scenarios rendered by Blender, as shown in Fig. 9 , which is a common practice in event camera simulation [ 57 ] . In the simulation set, we design three different scenarios, tree, sky and smog, within which we simulate blobs moving randomly. Using the bounding box-based tracking GTs generated by Blender, we convert them into event-wise labels following the same procedure as in Ev-UAV. While Ev-UAV mainly contains trajectories with large spatio-temporal breaks, SOD features target overlapping and static background occlusion. SOD will be made available in our repository, and more information about the simulated subset (SOD-b) is provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 由于基于事件的愿景中小型和多个物体跟踪数据集数量有限,我们收集了SOD,以包括小型的、独立快速移动的评价目标。 与前三套低空间分辨率(240×360 240\times 360)和单移动元素(相机或物体)不同的是,SOD使用高空间分辨率(720×1280 720\times 1280)事件相机录制, 预言EVK4,并同时提供相机和物体运动的情景. 它由表一所列的两个部分组成,即现实世界和模拟数据。 真实世界的序列在三种户外情景中被捕获,即树,操场,以及雨水. 根据目标类型和数量,它们分为20、30和雨滴。 Sphere-20和Sphere-30序列记录了在树和干净的游乐场景中手动投掷的大理石,而雨滴序列则记录了降雨滴. 如图9所示,模拟序列是通过屏幕记录Blender提供的各种情景生成的,这是事件相机模拟的常见做法[57]. 在模拟场景中,我们设计了三种不同的场景,树,天空和烟雾,在其中我们模拟随机移动的blobs. 使用Blender生成的基于边框的跟踪GT,我们按照Ev-UAV的相同程序将其转换成事件导向的标签. 虽然Ev-UAV主要包含具有大片溅射时断裂的轨迹,但SOD特征是瞄准重叠和静态背景隔离. 将在我们的储存库中提供SOD,并在补充材料中提供关于模拟子集(SOD-b)的更多信息。

blocks.en: IV-B Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 四-B 评价指标

blocks.en: To comprehensively evaluate our framework, we employ both bounding box-based and event-wise MOT metrics. The former aligns with standard metrics in image-based MOT, including Precision (P), Recall (R), Multiple Object Tracking Accuracy (MOTA) [ 58 ] , and Feature Age (FA) [ 40 ] . By default, FA is evaluated over all trajectories. For a fair comparison, we evaluate only the longest trajectories, with counts equalized to 20% and 50% of the minimum trajectory total across all methods, visualized via box plots. In these plots, boxes represent the interquartile range (25%-75%), with blue and red lines marking the median and mean, and whiskers showing the full data range. Event-wise metrics are derived from event-based segmentation metrics [ 21 ] , specifically Segmentation IoU (Seg. IoU) and Segmentation Accuracy (Seg. Acc). We extend them to Track IoU and Track Acc, and add IDF1 [ 58 ] to evaluate tracking stability. As box-based metrics rely on GT bounding boxes, they may yield biased evaluations when events of one trajectory are temporarily misassigned to another trajectory. Therefore, event-wise metrics serve as the primary indicators.
blocks.zh: 为了全面评估我们的框架,我们既采用以框为主,又采用以事件为主的MOT指标。 前者与基于图像的MOT中的标准度量衡一致,包括精度(P),回忆(R),多物体跟踪精确度(MOTA)[58],以及特性年龄(FA)[40]. 默认情况下,FA会在所有轨迹上进行评价. 为了进行公平的比较,我们只评估最长的轨迹, 计数等于所有方法最低轨迹总量的20%和50%, 通过盒子图可视化。 在这些图中,框代表方块间距(25%-75%),蓝线和红线标注中值和平均值,胡须标出全部数据范围。 以事件为主的衡量尺度来自基于事件分解的衡量尺度[21],具体而言是分解IoU(如IoU)和分解精确度(如Acc)。 我们把它们扩大到IoU轨道和Acc轨道,并增加以色列国防军1[58],以评估跟踪稳定性。 由于以框为基础的衡量标准依赖于GT边界框,当一个轨迹的事件被暂时误用于另一个轨迹时,它们可能会产生偏差的评价. 因此,以事件衡量尺度作为主要指标。

blocks.zh: 四-C 与非学习方法的结合

blocks.en: We integrate three classic image-based segmentation methods, region growing [ 59 ] , watershed [ 60 ] , and Mean Shift [ 61 ] into MvT, denoted as MvT+RG, MvT+WS, and MvT+MS. Implementations are provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们综合了三种典型的基于图像的分割方法,区域生长[59],分水岭[60],平均移移[61]到MvT,表示为MvT+RG,MvT+WS,和MvT+MS. 补充材料提供了执行情况。

blocks.en: Comparing Methods. In this section, we compare our MvT with existing event-based MOT methods. For pseudo-frame methods, we compare against ETD [ 5 ] and RMRNet [ 6 ] . For the event-by-event paradigm, we evaluate against AEBTracker [ 38 ] (AEBT), AEMOT [ 20 ] , and E-MS [ 7 ] . Since ETD, RMRNet, and AEBT require GT initialization of object positions, they are evaluated exclusively on ECD. AEMOT incorporates a binary classifier trained on 28 × 28 28\times 28 intensity patches, which are only available in BEES. For BEES and SOD, we additionally employ the spatter tracking method from Prophesee software [ 62 ] as a baseline, denoted as PROPHESEE. Since PROPHESEE generates bounding boxes at each evaluation window, we convert the boxes into event trajectories for evaluation and visualization.
blocks.zh: 比较方法。 在本节中,我们将我们的MvT与现有的基于事件的MOT方法进行比较. 就假框架方法而言,我们比较ETD[5]和RMRNet[6]。 对于逐项活动的范式,我们比照AEBTracker[38](AEBT),AEMOT[20],以及E-MS[7]来评价. 由于ETD,RMRNet,以及AEBT需要GT初始化对象位置,所以它们完全在ECD上评价. AEMOT包含一个二进制分类器,经过28×28 28\时28强度补丁的训练,这些补丁只在BEES中提供. 对于BEES和SOD,我们额外使用来自Prophee软件的Spatcher跟踪方法作为基线,表示为PROPHESE. 由于PROPHESEE在每个评价窗口生成边框,我们把盒子转换成事件轨迹,用于评价和可视化.

blocks.en: In terms of the tracking metrics MOTA and IDF1, the MvT variants (MvTs) achieve the top three across all scenarios. Unlike Track IoU and Track Acc, which only reflect the percentage of true positive events within each GT trajectory, the leading MOTA and IDF1 scores of MvTs demonstrate stronger long-term tracking and association capabilities compared to other methods. As shown in Fig. 10 , RMRNet produces less smooth trajectories than other methods, as it treats event-based tracking purely as an image-based task. MvT+MS, which utilizes the same clustering strategy Mean Shift as E-MS, yields more accurate tracking and continuous trajectories than E-MS. Among MvTs, MvT+RG and MvT+MS achieve the best overall performance, while MvT+WS consistently yields the lowest Track IoU and Track Acc, revealing that it fails to capture the majority of target events.
blocks.zh: 在跟踪度量衡MOTA和IDF1方面,MvT变体(MvTs)在所有情景中都实现了前三位. 轨迹IoU和轨迹Acc只反映每个GT轨迹中真实正态事件的百分比,不同的是,领先的MOTA和IDF1的MvT分数显示出比其他方法更强的长期跟踪和关联能力. 如图10所示,RMRNet的轨迹比其他方法的平滑性要小,因为它将基于事件的跟踪纯粹视为基于图像的任务. MvT+MS采用与电子管理系统相同的集群战略Mean Shift,比电子管理系统更准确的跟踪和连续轨迹。 在MvTs中,MvT+RG和MvT+MS实现了最佳的整体性能,而MvT+WS则持续产生最低音轨IoU和音轨Acc,揭示出它未能捕捉大多数目标事件.

blocks.en: The runtime efficiency of MvT depends primarily on the adopted image-based method. As shown in Table II , MvT+RG and MvT+WS achieve near real-time speeds of 19-26 FPS, which is higher than RMRNet and ETD. MvT+MS drops to 0.18-0.19 FPS because the Mean Shift in the scikit-learn module is computationally expensive and cannot be executed in parallel. Nevertheless, MvT strikes a balance between efficiency and tracking accuracy.

blocks.en: IV-D Integration with learning-based methods
blocks.zh: 四-D 与基于学习的方法相结合

blocks.en: We integrate learning-based methods into MvT to expand its applicability to complex scenarios. Two event-based datasets are used, Ev-UAV and SOD-b. Since object trajectories exhibit distinct spatio-temporal patterns in the YOT and TOX views, appearance-based upstream models perform poorly in these views. Consequently, we adopt an asymmetric strategy, applying learning-based models to the XOY view while utilizing an appearance-independent region growing method for the YOT and TOX. We evaluate six learning-based models, including two image-based models (YOLOX [ 63 ] and SEGMAN [ 64 ] ), two event-based models (RVT [ 65 ] and EV-SpSegNet [ 21 ] ), and two event-based SOT models (HDETrack [ 66 ] and TSETrack [ 67 ] ). For MOT comparisons, we select two prevailing image-based trackers, a bounding box-based OCSORT [ 68 ] and a segmentation-based DEVA [ 69 ] , besides two event-based SOT models. Since SOD-b is a small-scale set, we only train models on the training set of Ev-UAV and evaluate on SOD-b and the remaining sets of Ev-UAV.
blocks.zh: 我们把基于学习的方法整合到MvT中,以扩大其适用于复杂的情景. 使用了两个基于事件的数据集,Ev-UAV和SOD-b. 由于物体的轨迹在YOT和TOX视图中表现出明显的斯皮提奥-时态模式,基于外观的上游模型在这些视图中表现不佳. 因此,我们采取一种不对称的战略,在XOY观点中采用基于学习的模式,同时对YOT和TOX采用外观独立的区域生长方法。 我们评价了六个基于学习的模型,包括两个基于图像的模型(YOLOX [63]和SEGMAN [64]),两个基于事件模型(RVT [65]和EV-SpSegNet [21]),以及两个基于事件的SOT模型(HDETrack [66]和TSETrack [67]). 对于MOT比较,我们除了选择两个基于事件的SOT模型外,还选择了两个流行的基于图像的跟踪器,一个基于边框的OCSORT [68] 和一个基于分区的DEVA [69]. 由于SOD-b是一个小规模的集,我们只用Ev-UAV的训练集来训练模型,并且评价SOD-b和其余的Ev-UAV的系列.

blocks.en: (1) Tracking on Ev-UAV. All methods are evaluated with B = 50 B=50 ms . Results are reported in Table IV and Fig. 15 . Excluding the two SOT models, our method achieves the best and most stable tracking performance across the remaining four upstream models. Specifically, integrating MvT with YOLOX and RVT outperforms the detection-based OCSORT by over 15% Track IoU, 7% Track Acc, and 10% IDF1, and surpasses the segmentation-based DEVA by over 14% Track IoU, 28% Track Acc, and 43% IDF1. However, our method yields lower segmentation performance than the original upstream models. This degradation occurs because the multi-view strategy recognizes scattered events around trajectories as outliers. As illustrated in the first row of Fig. 16 , TSETrack+MvT classifies surrounding events as outliers due to their irregular distribution in the TOX view (Fig. 16 (c)). Although this discards some valid trajectory points, the resulting trajectories remain smooth and trackable. The two SOT models, HDETrack and TSETrack, achieve IDF1 scores of nearly 100%. Their low false positives and false negatives can be attributed to supervised training, GT initialization, and the small number of tracking targets. To evaluate the generalization of these methods, we conduct further experiments on SOD-b without fine-tuning.

blocks.en: IV-E Case Study
blocks.zh: 四-E 案例研究

blocks.en: This study is to validate the tracking disambiguation of our framework compared to the pseudo-frame representation. In Fig. 17 , we present two cases involving occluded and closely distributed trajectories. Sub-figure (a) shows the results of MvT+TSETrack/RG and sub-figure (b) shows the results of MvF+TSETrack/RG. Since TSETrack is a voxel-grid-based model and RG operates on a single view, we integrate our MvF module with them to construct the voxel-grid variant and the single-view variant, denoted as MvF+TSETrack and MvF+RG, respectively. In the first row of Fig. 17 , the single-view variant fails to distinguish trajectories from occlusions, whereas our multi-view model succeeds. For closely distributed objects, the single-view method cannot determine whether the events mapped to a pixel originate from one object. This causes several trajectory segments with the same color to be discretely distributed in the T-X-Y space. In contrast, our multi-view representation effectively separates them.

blocks.en: The Gaussian pyramid is a crucial component in our MvP module, designed to mitigate the pattern discretization of event distributions in views. The design of Gaussian kernels and the number of layers are essential for its effectiveness. We test a series of values for these parameters to determine the best combination. The kernel design involves two parameters, kernel size k k and standard deviation σ \sigma in Gaussian kernels. We initially set the downsampling scale s = 0.8 s=0.8 , and the stopband edge gain α = 26 \alpha=26 dB. Then the lower bound of σ \sigma for anti-aliasing is σ a ​ n ​ t ​ i = 0.974 \sigma_{anti}=0.974 . The tested values of σ \sigma and k k are σ ∈ { 0.974 , 1.0 , 1.1 , 1.2 , 1.3 , 1.4 , 1.5 , 1.6 , 1.7 } \sigma\in\{0.974,1.0,1.1,1.2,1.3,1.4,1.5,1.6,1.7\} , and k ∈ { 3 , 5 , 7 , 9 , 11 , 13 } k\in\{3,5,7,9,11,13\} . We evaluate parameter sensitivity on the ECD dataset using RG (Fig. 18 ) and WS (Fig. 19 ). Fig. 18 reveals that variations in σ \sigma have almost no impact on final tracking performance. This is because RG identifies components based on non-zero pixel connectivity ( > 0 >0 for the target and = 0 =0 for the background). Under this binary criterion, the Gaussian kernel with continuous weighting acts like a box filter. However, as k k spans [ 3 , 13 ] [3,13] , performance fluctuations become noticeable with a maximum of 15%.

blocks.en: In Fig. 19 , when k = 3 k=3 , all σ \sigma values perform similarly well, with slightly higher Recall, Track Acc, and Track IDF1 when σ ≥ 1.4 \sigma\geq 1.4 . Unlike RG, when k ≥ 5 k\geq 5 , WS achieves its best performance when σ \sigma lies in [ 0.974 , 1.1 ] [0.974,1.1] , which is around the anti-aliasing lower bound σ a ​ n ​ t ​ i \sigma_{anti} . As σ \sigma grows, performance degrades significantly. This discrepancy stems from their distinct mechanisms, as WS relies more heavily on structural patterns. To comprehensively accommodate different image-based techniques, the Gaussian kernel is configured as k = 3 k=3 and σ = 1.6 \sigma=1.6 . Although k = 3 k=3 does not yield the optimal trade-off for RG, it clearly achieves the best performance for WS. Larger kernels may suppress more noise and connect broken tracklets, yielding higher Precision, but they cause noticeable performance fluctuations and risk over-smoothing adjacent trajectory patterns. blocks.en: We conduct ablation studies on two components, multi-view representation and time realignment.

blocks.en: (1) Multi-view representation . We evaluate our multi-view representation (MvP) against a voxel-grid-based representation (VG, ∈ ℝ H × W × T \in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times T} , T = 200 T=200 ) and a single-view representation (SingV, ∈ ℝ H × W \in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W} ). While MvP and SingV share a 2D frame format, VG is inherently 3D data. To comprehensively evaluate VG against MvP, we design four experiments addressing different VG processing paradigms. First, project the 3D VG onto the same orthogonal views (XOY, YOT, TOX) used in MvP. This process is mathematically equivalent to applying MvP without the Time Realignment (TR) module. As shown in the subsequent ablation study (Table VIII and Table IX ), MvP consistently outperforms this VG-projection variant. Second, apply the 3D Mean Shift to VG. Third, treat VG as a multi-channel 2D image, where the same 2D Mean Shift is applied independently to each channel. Fourth, utilize an event-based VG detector, RVT, as the upstream model to compare tracking performance under the VG and MvP pipelines. The latter three experiments, denoted as VG-①, VG-②, and VG-③, are conducted on ECD and Ev-UAV, with results in Table VI and Table VII . All variants are evaluated under identical parameter settings.

blocks.en: In Table VI , the MvP variant significantly outperforms two VG variants across all metrics and leads the SingV variant in most metrics. In Table VII , the MvP variant again outperforms the VG variant by a large margin, achieving improvements of over 14% in Track IoU and 2% in Track Acc. This confirms that MvP successfully isolates true trajectories from adjacent trajectories or background noise. We also observe a drop in IDF1 for the MvP variant. This is because in the VG model, spatially close events are often merged into one trajectory, artificially maintaining ID consistency. In contrast, the MvP variant distinguishes individual tracklets across multiple views, inevitably increasing the number of identities and lowering IDF1, as illustrated in Fig. 17 . Furthermore, we integrate an image-based detector, YOLOX, to evaluate the MvP and SingV representations on Ev-UAV. The MvP model outperforms the SingV model by 16% in Track IoU, 9% in Track Acc, and 10% in IDF1, further confirming the effectiveness of our representation.

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: Comprehensive evaluations across four datasets featuring objects of varying scales and motion patterns demonstrate the effectiveness, generalization, and flexibility of the MvT framework. By integrating with diverse upstream detection or segmentation models, MvT successfully adapts to a wide range of tracking environments.
blocks.zh: 以不同规模和运动模式为对象的4个数据集的综合评价显示了MvT框架的有效性、普遍性和灵活性。 MvT通过融合多种上游检测或分解模型,成功适应了广泛的跟踪环境.

blocks.en: However, as the association model of our method relies on motion continuity rather than appearance features or specifically learned motion models, it may struggle during prolonged occlusions accompanied by significant directional changes. Specifically, while Δ ​ θ \Delta\theta in association Criterion 2 bounds directional calculation errors, it restricts the motion model to near-linear assumptions. The optimal Δ ​ θ \Delta\theta may vary for objects with different motion patterns. Future work will explore adaptive methods to dynamically determine Δ ​ θ \Delta\theta based on object characteristics or complex motion models. Currently, MvT utilizes only the spatio-temporal coordinates ( t t , x x , y y ) of each event. As introduced in Sec. I , some researchers [ 13 , 14 ] have leveraged event polarity to reconstruct intensity images containing rich texture and appearance information. Integrating polarity and its underlying intensity gradient field to infer object motion represents a promising direction for adaptively determining Δ ​ θ \Delta\theta . Lastly, the isotropic Gaussian kernel used in MvP may not be optimal for all views, as pattern discontinuities vary across projection views. Furthermore, our Gaussian kernel experiments show that optimal kernel designs also differ across objects. It is a worthwhile direction for future to explore adaptive kernel shapes and sizes to better mitigate pattern discontinuities, especially in cases of complex motion combinations or varying object sizes.
blocks.zh: 然而,由于我们方法的关联模型依赖于运动连续性,而不是外观特征或具体学到的动作模型,在长期隔离期间,伴随着重大的方向变化,它可能会挣扎. 具体来说,虽然在关联Criterion 2中的QQ\Delta\theta限制方向计算错误,但它将运动模型限制在近线性假设. 最佳的 QQ \ Delta\theta 对运动模式不同的对象可能有所不同。 未来的工作将探索适应方法,根据物体特征或复杂的运动模型,动态地确定 \\\\\Delta\theta。 目前,MvT只使用每个事件的时空坐标(t t, x x, y ). 正如Sec. I介绍的那样,一些研究者[13,14]利用事件极性来重建包含丰富的纹理和外观信息的强度图像. 结合极性及其基本的强度梯度场来推断物体运动,是适应性地确定 \\\\Delta\theta 的一个有希望的方向。 最后,MvP中使用的异热带高斯内核可能不是所有视图的最佳选择,因为图案不连续性因投影观点而异. 此外,我们的高斯内核实验表明,最佳内核设计也因物体而异. 未来探索适应性内核形状和大小,以更好地缓解规律不连续,特别是在复杂的运动组合或物体大小不同的情况下,这是一个值得遵循的方向.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we have presented MvT, a general framework that leverages an intuitive multi-view representation to effectively encode spatio-temporal information from event streams for event-based tracking.
Our representation enables the direct application of image-based upstream detection or segmentation algorithms while leveraging complementary dimensional information to resolve tracking ambiguities, such as occlusion and overlap, in a single view. An association model consisting of three criteria under different scenarios further ensures robust tracklet linking and stable performance. Comprehensive experiments across four datasets demonstrate that MvT can flexibly integrate with learning-based and non-learning-based models to reliably track objects of varying sizes, outperforming existing event-based methods. Crucially, as a training-free approach, MvT enables robust tracking even in extreme scenarios where GT annotations are unobtainable, positioning it as a practical and generalizable framework for event-based tracking in real-world applications.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们提出了MvT,这是一个总的框架,它利用直观的多视图表达,有效地将事件流中的时空信息编码为事件跟踪.
我们的表述使基于图像的上游检测或分解算法能够直接应用,同时利用互补的维度信息解决跟踪的模糊性,例如隐蔽和重叠。 由不同情景下的三项标准组成的联合模式进一步确保了牢固的轨道连接和稳定的性能。 跨越四个数据集的全面实验表明,MvT可以灵活地与基于学习的模型和非基于学习的模型结合,以可靠地跟踪大小不一的物体,优于现有基于事件的方法. 关键的是,作为一种无培训方法,MvT即使在GT说明无法实现的极端情景中也能实现强力跟踪,将其定位为现实世界应用中基于事件跟踪的实用和通用框架.
